Entrance cutscenes are a subset of [[cutscenes]] that play when entering a scene using a specific entrance index value. 
{{clear}}

== Format ==
Each record follows the following format:

<tt>eeee aaff bbbb bbbb</tt>
 
'''e''' = [[entrance index]] used to trigger the cutscene<br>
'''a''' = an age restriction code. 00 for adult only cutscenes, 01 for child only cutscenes, 02 for no restriction<br>
'''f''' = [[event_chk_inf]] flag. See page for an explanation on how this value works<br>
'''b''' = [[segment offset]] location of the cutscene. Always starts with 02 for scene offset.<br>

The event flag is used to record whether the cutscene should has already been shown or not, except for the cutscenes that play whenever you leave Lon Lon ranch with Epona (which are instead used to set that you own Epona). This flag can be used to turn on a single bit at offsets 0x0ED4 - 0x0F13 from the start of the saved data. See [[Save Format]] for a list of ram offsets for the starting locations for the save data.
